summary: Keep Liepin city selection within the requested section, reconcile picker effects from bounded readonly state, and preserve one action trace per logical cards query.
rationale: The live Liepin page exposes current city and expected city as different filters, while the adapter treated them as fallback aliases. The city picker can also expose its search input in the real DOM while WTSCLI state omits that semantic control, and same-name sidebar navigation is not a selectable city result. This change removes cross-section lookup and verification, adds one allowlisted readonly city-picker probe that returns only bounded refs and city state, treats only the exact open-but-input-not-ready render as transient readiness, reconciles option and confirm effects before authorizing any further picker effect, verifies the requested search input before accepting delayed suggestions, excludes navigation nodes from selectable results, and keys cards action traces by a privacy-safe operation fingerprint so queries in one source lane cannot overwrite each other.
